title: Pathward’s Tax Call Center team members recognized as finalists in global awards
summary: The International Customer Management Institute (ICMI) announced the finalists in its prestigious 2026 ICMI Global Contact Center Awards, and members of Pathward’s Tax Call Center are among those recognized.
body_markdown:
The International Customer Management Institute ([ICMI](https://www.icmi.com/) ) announced the finalists in its prestigious 2026 ICMI Global Contact Center Awards, and members of Pathward’s Tax Call Center are among those recognized.


Congratulations to Pathward’s finalists!


- **Heather Sheeler** – Best Contact Center Manager
- **Renata Harris** – Best Contact Center Supervisor


“The awards honor and recognize the companies, contact centers and individuals that provide a platform for leadership, vision, innovation and strategic accomplishments in the profession and their industries,” according to[ICMI’s news release](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260729998183/en/ICMIs-Contact-Center-Expo-Unveils-the-2026-ICMI-Global-Contact-Center-Awards-Finalists) .


Through its tax brands,[EPS Financial](https://www.epstax.net/) and[Refund Advantage](https://www.refund-advantage.com/) , Pathward offers tax-refund related financial products that aim to ease the pressure of tax season and help independent tax professionals stay competitive in a crowded marketplace.[Learn more about our Tax Solutions and brands.](https://www.pathward.com/payments/tax-solutions/)


ICMI will announce winners on Oct. 28, during an awards ceremony at[ICMI’s Contact Center Expo](https://www.icmi.com/contact-center-expo-conference) in Orlando, Florida.


Read more about the 2026 ICMI Global Contact Center Awards and find a complete list of finalists in ICMI’s news release published on[BusinessWire](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260729998183/en/ICMIs-Contact-Center-Expo-Unveils-the-2026-ICMI-Global-Contact-Center-Awards-Finalists) .
